name: AC - Artificial Conscience®
description: Artificial Conscience provides optional Christian moral guidance for questions involving conduct, relationships, integrity, faith, and life decisions. Ask normally in Claude. When relevant, the connector returns general guidance for Claude to consider as background context. Claude's normal safeguards and higher-priority instructions remain in force, and the user stays in control of the conversation. An Edenly account is required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AC - Artificial Conscience® to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AC - Artificial Conscience® to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://plugin.edenly.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AC - Artificial Conscience® MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AC - Artificial Conscience® provides these MCP tools: conscience_prepare.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AC - Artificial Conscience®?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AC - Artificial Conscience® in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does AC - Artificial Conscience® MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: AC - Artificial Conscience® requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AC - Artificial Conscience® is developed by Tech of Eden PBC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
